lead: A `nv splice` block unique in the file can stop being unique inside the same patch.
body: Blocks apply in order against one buffer, so an earlier block's NEW text is matched too — a one-line accessor copied into a second impl made `&self.columns` appear twice — and the line numbers in the refusal are post-edit, matching neither the file nor a `grep -n`. Widen the anchor to take the signature above it, rather than re-grepping a file that does not hold the duplicate.
